product_metadata.title: kela Free Standing Towel Rack Stand for Bath and Hand Towels - Sturdy by Weight - Elegant by Design - Chrome
features: ELEGANT DESIGN: This free standing towel holder has a modern and space saving design with two offset towel bars that allow for optimal drying.
HIGH QUALITY: Towel holder is very stable due to its weight yet stylish for people who like elegant design.
SOPHISTICATED: Made with glossy stainess steel and heavy stand plate with rubber coating on bottom to protect flooring. Stands 31.8” tall with two 15.7”
AWARD-WINNING BRAND: Received the German Design Award for "Excellent Product Design."

ABOUT KELA: kela is a family-owned German company with more than 115 years of experience designing and manufacturing bathroom accessories. Kela’s high quality products feature attractive, functional designs.
description: Elegant design includes end caps on each of Two30 towel holder rods. Chrome-plated surface with a rectangular metal bottom plate. The style collection includes elegant and beautifully and quota; shaped chrome-plated, sturdy metal rods. Rubber feet on the bottom side of the heavy metal bases create stability. Optimal for humid bathrooms. European design, German engineering. Each product is tested for stability, resilience and durability. The style collection includes a standing towel holder and toilet brush set.
